application: Voluntarily adopted Labour Department normal-desk-work minimum recommendation only
advisory_notes: Page 8 paragraph 8 recommends 300-500 lx as optimum for normal desk work and says it should never fall below 200 lx. Only the latter recommendation is evaluated here.

Page 11 Appendix lists optimum average examples: general offices 500 lx, computer workstations 500 lx, drawing workstations 750 lx, other listed areas 300 lx. These examples are not converted into statutory minimums or maximums.
Do not derive minimum illuminance by multiplying rounded report average and uniformity. The tested Summary reader does not extract the required minimum or identify a normal-desk-work task surface.
Passing this recommendation does not establish optimum lighting, glare control, uniformity, energy compliance, or compliance under all operating conditions.

source.applicability: Advisory minimum for normal desk work, explicitly adopted for reviewed task surfaces and operating conditions; not a statutory threshold or average-illuminance criterion.
